title: Depth 4 -> 8 layers (6.4M params, under the 10M cap)
description: Same width 256, 8 heads, double the depth. Each step costs ~2x, so about 1000 steps (2 epochs) in 240 s instead of 2000.
hypothesis: Longer proofs need more sequential reasoning per token (find a citation, apply a rule); depth buys that more than width. Dan's scale runs (25M/85M) did not help, but those were width-and-depth at long budgets. Risk: half the steps at this budget leaves the model undertrained like 003 (greedy 0.78 -> metric 14).
surprise: Half the steps (1000), greedy 0.81, and sampling at 296/s (2x the per-token cost plus more runaway generations from undertraining): EI round 1 alone took 219 s. Under a fixed total budget, depth pays twice, in pretrain steps and in sampling time.
